name: agent-watch
description: A themeable Windows home for your local coding agents.
author: William Pyle

scripts.test:desktop: node scripts/desktop-smoke.mjs && node scripts/world-smoke.mjs && node scripts/smurfs-smoke.mjs
scripts.build: npm run themes:check && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
A new downloadable Smurfs village for your agents.

- Papa Smurf coordinates; Smurfette, Brainy, Jokey, Hefty and a reusable generic Smurf have their own artwork and routines.
- Six character sheets with 36 poses, 24 scenery types, 15 activities and a complete editable woodland village.
- Mushroom homes, trees, smurfberry bushes, a well, bridges, workshop, library, alchemy bench, bakery and festival stage.
- Flowing water, chimney smoke, custom homes and work destinations.
- Role characters stay reserved during automatic assignment; additional agents use the theme-selected reusable character.

After installing, open Theme library, refresh the GitHub catalog, download Smurfs and choose Use theme. Robot Datacenter remains the bundled default.

Validation: 33 unit tests, desktop and packaged tests, sprite transparency, coordinator assignment, extra villagers, connected paths and saved layout checks.

Download Agent-Watch-Setup-0.3.0-x64.exe below. Builds remain unsigned.
